item.title: Melbourne Student Suburb Guide 2026 — Where to Live, Study & Survive
item.description:
Melbourne Student Suburb Guide

Melbourne has over 300,000 uni and TAFE students spread across dozens of suburbs. Picking where to live is one of the biggest decisions you’ll make — and most people get it wrong because they either overpay for a shoebox in the CBD or end up 90 minutes from campus in a suburb with nothing going on.

This guide exists to fix that. Every article is written by people who actually lived in these suburbs as students, not real estate agents trying to sell you something.

item.title: Southbank Melbourne — Hub Page
item.description:
Southbank, Melbourne

Southbank sits directly across the Yarra from the CBD in the City of Melbourne (postcode 3006). Melbourne’s premier entertainment, arts, and high-rise residential precinct — home to Crown Casino, Arts Centre Melbourne, the NGV, Eureka Tower, and the Southbank Promenade.

Key streets: Southbank Boulevard, City Road, Clarendon Street, Sturt Street, Kavanagh Street.

Getting here: No dedicated train station. Nearest is Flinders Street (5 min walk across the river). Tram 96 along Southbank Boulevard, tram 12 along Clarendon Street.

item.title: Moving to Melbourne: The No-Bullshit Suburb Finder
item.description:
Moving to Melbourne is one of the better decisions you’ll make. Living in the wrong suburb of Melbourne is one of the worse ones.

The gap between “I love this city” and “I need to move back” is often just a bad suburb fit \u2014 too far from work, too expensive for what you get, the wrong kind of neighbourhood for how you actually live. This guide exists to help you get that right from the start.
